Name: Arrow, Iron-Tipped Distance (20)
Description: These arrows have iron tips and are designed for increased range.

Name: Arrows (20)
Description: Standard arrows for bows. An arrow that hits its target is destroyed; one that misses has a 50% chance of being destroyed or lost.

Name: Atlatl Dart
Description: Specially fitted dart designed for use with an atlatl.

Name: Bamboo Shaft Arrows (20)
Description: These lightweight arrows have bamboo shafts, making them easier to carry.

Name: Barbed Arrow (20)
Description: These arrows have barbs that make them difficult to remove, dealing additional damage when extracted.

Name: Blowgun Darts (10)
Description: These thin, light darts are typically used with a blowgun. They deal minimal damage but are excellent for delivering poison.

Name: Blunt Arrows (20)
Description: These arrows have blunted tips and deal nonlethal damage.

Name: Bolas Bolts
Description: These special crossbow bolts entangle the target on a successful hit.

Name: Bolt, Acid
Description: This bolt is filled with acid and deals additional acid damage on a hit.

Name: Bolt, Drow Poison
Description: This bolt is coated with drow poison.

Name: Bolt, Fire
Description: This bolt is filled with alchemist's fire and deals additional fire damage on a hit.

Name: Bolts, Heartstake (5)
Description: These wooden bolts are designed to pierce the hearts of vampires.

Name: Bullets, Groaning (10)
Description: These bullets make a groaning sound when fired, potentially frightening opponents.

Name: Crossbow Bolts (10)
Description: Standard crossbow bolts. A bolt that hits its target is destroyed; one that misses has a 50% chance of being destroyed or lost.

Name: Featherweight Dart (10)
Description: These extremely light darts can be thrown or used with a blowgun.

Name: Flight Arrows (20)
Description: These arrows are lighter and more aerodynamic, increasing range increment by 10 feet.

Name: Halfling Little Starstones (10)
Description: These small stones deal minimal nonlethal damage. Halflings treat these as martial ammunition.

Name: Halfling Sharpstones (10)
Description: These sharp stones can deal piercing or slashing damage. Halflings treat these as martial ammunition.

Name: Halfling Softstones (10)
Description: These soft stones deal nonlethal damage. Halflings treat these as martial ammunition.

Name: Halfling Spongestones (10)
Description: These porous stones can absorb liquids like poison or alchemical substances. Halflings treat these as martial ammunition.

Name: Incendiary Arrow (20)
Description: These arrows deal additional fire damage and can ignite flammable objects.

Name: Kestros Dart (10)
Description: Specially weighted darts designed for use with a kestros.

Name: Pronged Arrow (20)
Description: These arrows have multiple prongs and can be used to grapple or disarm.

Name: Repeating Crossbow Bolts (5)
Description: These bolts are designed to fit in the magazine of a repeating crossbow.

Name: Sling Bullets (10)
Description: Shaped metal projectiles designed to be used with a sling. A bullet that hits its target is destroyed; one that misses has a 50% chance of being destroyed or lost.

Name: Smoke Arrow
Description: This arrow creates a burst of smoke on impact, creating concealment in a 5-foot radius for 1 round.

Name: Smoke Bullet
Description: This alchemical bullet creates a cloud of smoke on impact.

Name: Thistle Arrow
Description: This arrow is covered in barbed thistles that can entangle the target.

Name: Thorns (20)
Description: Natural thorns used as ammunition for a thorn bow.

Name: Throwing Arrow
Description: An arrow designed to be thrown by hand using a throwing cord.

Name: Whistling Arrows (20)
Description: These arrows come with a specially designed head that creates a loud whistle audible within a quarter-mile. They are often used for signaling allies or intimidating enemies.
